name: Neon Runner: Quiet Shift
description:
A backdoored CI runner sits in a neon corporate datacenter. Reconstruct what happened on the already-compromised host and recover the evidence it left behind. The box runs on the lab network; scan 172.20.0.0/24, where challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199.

---

**Access** — SSH `root@172.20.0.141`, password `NeonRunner!47`

tasks.name: Recover the runner's evidence
tasks.description: Investigate the already-compromised CI runner and recover the evidence left by its intruder. It runs on the lab network; scan 172.20.0.0/24, where challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199.
hints: Compare the host's ordinary activity across its accounts, login records, scheduled work, and shell histories.
Scheduled work can persist across reboots. Look closely at entries that do not fit the runner's routine maintenance and inspect any opaque values they contain.
Decode the long encoded value in the anomalous system-wide scheduled entry with base64; submit the recovered flag.
